correctness.rationale: The exact Dirichlet covariance calculation gives S=4GCG for any d≥1. C is SPD with determinant 1/[m^(d+1)(m+1)^d]. SPD square-root uniqueness proves injectivity and explicit inversion; any SPD S yields an SPD Gram realized by Cholesky. Volume follows from det G=(d! Vol)^2. 56 random examples and independent 600000-sample Dirichlet tests passed; finite checks are supplemental.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete inverse problem with labeled Euclidean geometry as output and low-order random interior distance observables as input: it classifies the exact range (all SPD matrices), has constructive unique inverse and reconstructs all edge lengths and volume in every finite dimension. The result is more informative than a routine expectation or one-parameter specialization.
